name: Satia Seyruun
original_name: サティア・セイルーン
source:
Satia is a traveler who serves Narsatia, God of Knowledge. She is very peace-loving, and seeks to end conflicts peacefully.

[spoiler]Her real identity is the old ancient goddess of justice, Astraea.[/spoiler]
